purpose: Explain the sealed V56 TNG100 train-only high-backbone failure without refitting or opening development or independent data. Partition the remaining physical second-moment excess below, inside, and beyond the fixed V56 survival grid; decompose every empirically supported threshold into survival-probability and conditional-amplitude errors; and attribute predicted tail probability and moment to permutation-invariant location-ranked mixture components.

population.probe: the identical deterministic V51/V53/V54/V56 4096-voxel probe per object
population.query_stratum: the domainwise q99.9-and-above query-backbone stratum using the exact boundaries sealed in the V56 train-gate decision

fixed_threshold_partition.lower_anchor_source: immutable V54 q99.999 common train threshold
fixed_threshold_partition.scored_grid_source: the exact immutable V56 16-cell survival grid

region_definitions.below_grid: at or below the q99.999 lower anchor
region_definitions.inside_grid: strictly above the lower anchor and at or below the final V56 grid threshold
region_definitions.beyond_grid: strictly above the final V56 grid threshold

fixed_threshold_partition.strict_exceedance_rule: log10rho is strictly greater than the threshold; equality remains in the lower bin

decomposition.threshold_rows: At the lower anchor and every V56 scored threshold, report empirical truth survival, analytic predicted survival, 64-point predicted tail moment, conditional tail amplitude, probability ratio, conditional-amplitude ratio, total tail-moment ratio, and their exact log-ratio identity whenever truth support is nonzero.
decomposition.bin_partition: Partition truth and predicted physical delta-squared over all 18 mutually exclusive output-density bins and report each bin's share of positive predicted-minus-truth moment excess.
decomposition.region_partition: Sum bin moments into below-grid, inside-grid, and beyond-grid regions and select a dominant region only when its share of positive moment excess is at least 0.5.
decomposition.component_ranking: At every query voxel, sort the five mixture components by increasing latent location before aggregation. This makes component ranks invariant to raw output-channel label permutations.
decomposition.component_rows: For each location rank, report mean mixture mass and its analytic survival-probability and quadrature physical-moment contributions at every threshold, plus its contribution to every output-density bin.
decomposition.supported_grid_error_summary: Over V56 scored thresholds with at least one empirical truth exceedance, compare physical-moment-weighted mean absolute log probability ratio with the corresponding mean absolute log conditional-amplitude ratio; renormalize the sealed V56 weights over supported cells only.
decomposition.component_dominance: A single location-ranked component dominates a tail when its predicted 64-point tail-moment share is at least 0.5; this is reported as mechanism evidence and does not alone select a model change.

numerics.primary: 64-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature of each of the five bounded-mixture components
numerics.analytic_probability: float64 bounded-mixture survival with exact zero or one outside support
numerics.unsupported_threshold_rule: Report predicted probability and moment but do not form truth ratios or use the threshold in probability-versus-amplitude classification.
numerics.failure_action: If reproduction, partition, quadrature, or supported-threshold identity checks fail, report all measurements but make no scientific mechanism classification and freeze a higher-accuracy train-only audit.

classification.target_domain: TNG100, the only V56 train-gate failure

branches.condition: TNG100 beyond-grid positive-excess share is at least 0.5
TNG100 below-grid positive-excess share is at least 0.5

TNG100 inside-grid positive-excess share is at least 0.5 and the supported-grid weighted mean absolute log probability ratio is strictly greater than the weighted mean absolute log conditional-amplitude ratio
TNG100 inside-grid positive-excess share is at least 0.5 and the supported-grid weighted mean absolute log conditional-amplitude ratio is at least the weighted mean absolute log probability ratio
